description: Construction of Stage - II of the Seven Storied Building for the Faculty of Graduate Studies, University of Colombo
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-04-03
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. S.B. Dissanayake, Minister of Higher Education to award the above contract to the lowest evaluated responsive bidder at a cost of Rs.228,604,705.00, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.
